en.Некоторые оптимизаторы выключают резерв: Some optimizers turn off the space reserved for updates with a DISM command and promise to free up several gigabytes.
en.Windows сама отдаёт этот резерв, когда м: Windows gives this reserve back by itself when space runs low — it exists so that updates can install even on a full drive. Disabling it speeds nothing up and only raises the chance that an update fails to install for lack of space.
en.Факты о дисках на «Панели» и очистка в «: The disk facts on the Dashboard and the cleanup in Maintenance show what is really taking up space.
en.Некоторые оптимизаторы выключают сжатие: Some optimizers turn off memory compression (Disable-MMAgent) or stop the SysMain service so that the “Memory Compression” process doesn't take up RAM.
en.Сжатые страницы занимают около 40 % свое: Compressed pages take about 40% of their original size and Windows writes to the page file half as often — it is memory the system keeps ready for other programs, not junk. Without compression, disk access grows under load and switching between programs slows down.
en.Факты о памяти на «Панели» показывают, с: The memory facts on the Dashboard show how much memory is really in use; SysMain is locked on the Startup & services page as a controversial setting.
en.Включить «нативный» драйвер NVMe из Wind: Enable the “native” NVMe driver from Windows Server
en.Некоторые руководства включают серверный: Some guides enable the server NVMe driver on Windows 11 through hidden FeatureManagement flags or ViVeTool for high IOPS in benchmarks.
en.Microsoft поддерживает этот путь только: Microsoft supports this path only on Windows Server 2025 and closed the registry workaround in 2026. On consumer SSDs, measurements showed no gain, while vendor disk utilities, SMART monitoring and BitLocker stopped working.
en.Факты о дисках на «Панели» (шина, здоров: The disk facts on the Dashboard (bus, health) and vendor utilities through Drivers.
en.Некоторые игровые бустеры и руководства: Some game boosters and BIOS guides forbid the CPU from entering idle states for the sake of “lower latency”.
en.Выход из C-state занимает микросекунды,: Exiting a C-state takes microseconds, while a frame takes milliseconds. The turbo frequency budget comes from the savings of sleeping cores, so without C-states single-core boost drops while idle heat and power draw rise.
en.Пункт «Минимальное состояние процессора: The “Minimum processor state 100%” option in Optimize honestly describes the same effect; power modes are changed through the change log.
en.Некоторые оптимизаторы и «таймер-сервисы: Some optimizers and “timer services” keep the system timer at 0.5 ms for all processes.
en.С Windows 10 2004 разрешение таймера зад: Since Windows 10 2004, timer resolution is set per process, and games request 1 ms on their own. A global mode adds nothing for games and only increases power consumption — Microsoft explicitly advises against it.
en.«Отчёт об энергоэффективности» в «Обслуж: The “Energy efficiency report” in Maintenance → Repair & disks shows which process is holding the timer.
en.Некоторые оптимизаторы ставят «минимум а: Some optimizers set “minimum active cores” to 100% or run “unparking” utilities.
en.На современных процессорах парковка нужн: On modern CPUs the scheduler needs parking: on dual-CCD Ryzen X3D it steers the game to the cores with the larger cache, and on hybrid Intel it works together with Thread Director. Forced “unparking” breaks this and adds no frames.
en.Проверка на «Панели» объясняет, зачем Ry: The check on the Dashboard explains why Ryzen X3D needs Game Mode; the “Power plan for Ryzen X3D (2 CCD)” and the power modes are in Optimize.
en.Некоторые оптимизаторы записывают PowerT: Some optimizers write PowerThrottlingOff=1 to “remove the limits on the CPU”.
en.Ограничение по питанию (Power Throttling: Power Throttling for invisible windows and background services only applies on battery, and EcoQoS is a flag that programs (browsers, messengers) set on themselves for background work. A game window in focus already gets high QoS, so this key gives the game nothing: on a desktop PC it just lets background programs use more, and on a laptop it drains the battery.
en.Игровой сеанс в «Играх» на время игры пе: The game session in Games switches the power plan (on desktop PCs) or the “Best performance” power mode (on laptops and PCs with Modern Standby) while you play, and puts everything back afterwards.
en.Некоторые руководства для Windows 11 24H: Some Windows 11 24H2 guides suggest the new DisableOverlays key instead of OverlayTestMode.
en.Ключ не документирован ни Microsoft, ни: The key is documented neither by Microsoft nor by NVIDIA and rests on a single forum post; there are reports that it breaks variable refresh rate (G-SYNC, FreeSync).
en.Пункт «Отключить MPO» в «Оптимизации» ис: The “Disable MPO” option in Optimize uses the documented NVIDIA key and honestly says that 24H2 may ignore it.
en.Фиксированный таймер гибернации на ноутб: Fixed hibernate timer on laptops with Modern Standby
en.Некоторые руководства ставят «гибернация: Some guides set “hibernate after 30 minutes” on laptops with Modern Standby so the battery doesn't drain in a bag.
en.Microsoft не рекомендует этот таймер для: Microsoft does not recommend this timer for Modern Standby systems: they use adaptive hibernation based on a drain budget. A fixed timer either fires too late and the battery drains completely, or cuts the power-saving standby short too early.
en.Отчёты SleepStudy и о батарее в «Обслужи: The SleepStudy and battery reports in Maintenance → Repair & disks → Power and sleep reports show the actual standby drain and its causes.
en.Некоторые оптимизаторы выключают гиберна: Some optimizers turn hibernation off (powercfg /h off) in their “basic” settings, including on laptops.
en.На ноутбуке действие при критическом зар: On a laptop, the critical battery action and Modern Standby fall back to hibernation — without it, unsaved work is lost. On a desktop PC, hybrid sleep stops working and a power cut during sleep wipes open documents.
en.Пункт «Отключить гибернацию» в «Оптимиза: The “Disable hibernation” option in Optimize is available only on desktop PCs, as an expert option, with a warning about hybrid sleep.
en.Вернуть S3-сон вместо Modern Standby: Bring back S3 sleep instead of Modern Standby
en.Некоторые оптимизаторы записывают Platfo: Some optimizers write PlatformAoAcOverride=0 so that a laptop “sleeps the old way” and drains less.
en.Это выключает Modern Standby, а прошивки: This turns Modern Standby off, and the firmware of such devices often doesn't implement S3 correctly: the laptop won't go to sleep, won't wake up or loses your work.
en.«Сон и пробуждение» и «Отчёты о питании: “Sleep and wake” and “Power and sleep reports” in Maintenance → Repair & disks show what prevents sleep and how much drains during a standby session.
en.Некоторые оптимизаторы ставят SvcHostSpl: Some optimizers set SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB to the amount of memory so that services live in shared processes again.
en.Microsoft разделила службы по процессам: Microsoft split services into separate processes for reliability and security: a crash in one doesn't take down the others. The saving is tens of megabytes of memory with no effect on games, and the side effect is problems with Xbox services.
en.Страница «Автозапуск и службы» объясняет: The Startup & services page explains what each service does and why Lycoris leaves some of them alone.
en.Периодическая очистка списка ожидания па: Periodic clearing of the memory standby list
en.Некоторые утилиты по таймеру сбрасывают: Some utilities flush the standby list on a timer or “free” RAM by trimming program working sets.
en.Страницы в списке ожидания уже считаются: Pages in the standby list already count as free and are handed out instantly, and flushing them forces data to be read from disk again — loading gets slower. Trimming working sets causes page faults and micro-stutters.
en.Одноразовая очистка памяти по желанию до: A one-time memory cleanup is available as an optional action, only in the game session, with an honest description of its effect.
en.Глобальный запрет фоновых приложений в W: Global ban on background apps in Windows 11
en.Некоторые оптимизаторы записывают Global: Some optimizers write GlobalUserDisabled=1 on Windows 11 or the LetAppsRunInBackground=2 policy.
en.В Windows 11 этот переключатель убран из: In Windows 11 this switch has been removed from the interface and current builds may ignore it, while the policy breaks notifications, alarms, Phone Link and the Xbox app. Store apps are already suspended and power-optimized anyway.
en.В «Оптимизации» фоновые приложения отклю: In Optimize, background apps are disabled one by one, and the global switch is offered only on Windows 10.
en.Некоторые оптимизаторы записывают Featur: Some optimizers write FeatureSettingsOverride, turning off the CPU's hardware mitigations for the sake of a couple of percent.
en.Это снимает защиту от уязвимостей процес: This removes protection against CPU vulnerabilities — weaker security in exchange for a few percent in rare CPU-bound scenarios.
en.Единственный компромисс с безопасностью: The only security trade-off in Lycoris is “Disable memory integrity (HVCI)” in Optimize, and it is an expert option with a warning.
en.Автопереключение настроек по активному п: Automatic settings switching by active app
en.Некоторые фирменные утилиты меняют схему: Some vendor utilities change the power plan, the mode and Windows settings every time you switch between programs.
en.Постоянные настройки, которые переписыва: Permanent settings that get rewritten in the background pile up layers in the change log and drift away from what you see — undoing “exactly one change” becomes impossible.
en.Игровой сеанс в «Играх» включается при з: The game session in Games starts when a game launches and puts everything back when you exit — one entry in the change log.
en.Некоторые игровые бустеры предлагают «от: Some game boosters offer to “disable CPU sleep” or “enable cores”, or set the Maximum performance plan by default.
en.На процессорах с CPPC это даёт 0–2 % сре: On CPUs with CPPC this gives 0–2% average FPS, and on dual-CCD Ryzen X3D and hybrid Intel it breaks thread distribution. One such booster's own support advises turning these options off when FPS drops.
en.Игровой сеанс меняет схему питания на вр: The game session changes the power plan for the duration of the game through the change log; “High performance” is offered only in the Games scenario on desktop PCs.
en.«Игровые» сборки Windows и плейбуки без: “Gaming” Windows builds and playbooks without protection
en.Некоторые сборки и плейбуки удаляют или: Some builds and playbooks remove or disable Defender, SmartScreen, Windows Update, CPU protection and memory integrity.
en.Измеримого выигрыша, который оправдал бы: There is no measurable gain that would justify this: the system is left without updates and protection, anti-cheats (Vanguard, FACEIT) require VBS, TPM and Secure Boot, and modified images may contain malicious code.
en.Весь каталог «Оптимизации» работает пове: The entire Optimize catalog works on top of regular Windows and can be undone from the change log.
en.«Экономия энергии» всегда включена как «: “Energy saver” always on as a “quiet PC”
en.Некоторые руководства включают «Экономию: Some guides keep “Energy saver” on permanently so a desktop PC runs quieter.
en.Большая часть экономии там идёт от блоки: Most of the saving there comes from blocking background work: mail and calendar sync and background apps are suspended and brightness is lowered. That is a loss of features, not quiet.
en.Пункт «Режим питания «Максимальная эффек: The “Max efficiency power mode on AC” option in Optimize (and optionally “No CPU turbo boost on AC”) is the documented way to make a PC quieter.
en.Некоторые оптимизаторы в режиме батареи: Some optimizers in battery mode ban all background apps, kill processes, clean RAM and disable Power Throttling.
en.Windows уже переводит фоновую работу в э: Windows already moves background work to an efficient mode (EcoQoS) and suspends Store apps. Banning them breaks notifications, alarms and Phone Link, cleaning RAM causes stutters, and disabling Power Throttling only drains the battery.
en.Отчёт о батарее в «Обслуживании → Ремонт: The battery report in Maintenance → Repair & disks → Power and sleep reports shows what really drains a laptop; background apps are disabled one by one in Optimize.
en.Приоритет DSCP и «сетевые ускорители» дл: DSCP priority and “network boosters” for streaming
en.Некоторые «сетевые ускорители» задают DS: Some “network boosters” set a DSCP priority for OBS, remove the “20% bandwidth reserve” and disable network card offloads.
en.Домашние провайдеры игнорируют или обнул: Home ISPs ignore or zero out DSCP marks, the “20% reserve” is a myth, and disabled offloads only load the CPU. The real cause of lag while streaming is bufferbloat, which is fixed by measuring and tuning the router.
en.Замер задержки под нагрузкой и подсказка: The latency-under-load test and the SQM router tip are on the Devices & network page.
en.Отключение турбобуста через «99 % максим: Disabling turbo boost through “99% maximum state”
en.Некоторые руководства ставят максимально: Some guides set the maximum processor state to 99% to disable turbo boost.
en.Отключение турбо при 99 % — недокументир: Turbo disabling at 99% is an undocumented side effect that doesn't work on every CPU, and on AMD with CPPC it can limit the frequency unpredictably.
en.Пункт «Без турбобуста процессора от сети: The “No CPU turbo boost on AC” option in Optimize uses the documented PERFBOOSTMODE setting.
en.Кривые вентиляторов и лимит заряда в обх: Fan curves and charge limit bypassing the vendor utility
en.Некоторые утилиты пишут режимы вентилято: Some utilities write fan modes, power limits and the battery charge limit directly through ACPI, WMI or the EC controller.
en.Это недокументированные интерфейсы конкр: These are undocumented vendor-specific interfaces: there is no exact undo, and a mistake risks overheating or firmware problems. The levers are real, but there is no safe way to verify them.
en.Страница «Устройства и сеть» ведёт к фир: The Devices & network page leads to the manufacturer's own app, and Drivers helps you install it.
en.Тёмная тема как часть режима автономност: Dark theme as part of a battery-saving mode
en.Некоторые режимы экономии батареи перекл: Some battery-saving modes switch the Windows theme to dark.
en.Экономия измерима только на OLED-экранах: The saving is measurable only on OLED screens; on LCD there is none. Appearance is a personal preference, and changing it as a side effect of a scenario only surprises people.
en.Lycoris тему не меняет; яркость и HDR мо: Lycoris does not change the theme; monitor brightness and HDR are configured on the Devices & network page.
en.Некоторые режимы «стрима» выключают все: Some “stream” modes turn off all notifications (ToastEnabled=0) or write undocumented Do Not Disturb settings.
en.Windows сама включает «Не беспокоить» во: Windows turns on Do Not Disturb by itself during games and in full-screen apps — this is on by default. A global off switch is too broad, and the Do Not Disturb settings store is undocumented and must not be written to.
en.Ничего менять не нужно: правило «Не бесп: There is nothing to change: the “Turn on Do Not Disturb automatically when I'm playing a game” rule is already on in Windows (Settings → System → Notifications → Turn on Do Not Disturb automatically); the game session in Games does not touch notifications.
en.«Высокая производительность» и очистка п: “High performance” and memory cleaning in non-gaming scenarios
en.Некоторые «рабочие» и «стрим»-режимы вкл: Some “work” and “stream” modes enable the High performance plan, a 100% processor minimum or memory cleaning.
en.Для офисных задач и аппаратных кодировщи: For office tasks and hardware encoders this speeds nothing up (0–2% on desktop PCs), while idle heat and power draw rise. Memory cleaning is mostly a placebo and can slow down loading.
en.Режимы питания в «Оптимизации» документи: The power modes in Optimize are documented; memory cleaning remains an optional action in the game session.
en.Политики полосы «Оптимизации доставки» к: Delivery Optimization bandwidth policies as a speed-up
en.Некоторые «ускорители интернета» задают: Some “internet boosters” set DOPercentageMaxBackgroundBandwidth policies or disable Delivery Optimization entirely.
en.Windows уже ограничивает фоновые загрузк: Windows already limits background downloads: no more than 45% of bandwidth (90% for on-demand downloads), and since Windows 11 22H2 it uses rLEDBAT, which yields bandwidth to interactive traffic. The policies only lock the setting in Windows Settings.
en.Пункт «Обновления без P2P-раздачи» в «Оп: The “Updates without P2P sharing” option in Optimize turns off sharing with other PCs; the download bandwidth limit is set in Windows Settings (Delivery Optimization → Advanced options); the bufferbloat test is in Devices & network.
en.Исключить библиотеки игр из индексатора: Excluding game libraries from the indexer “for FPS”
en.Некоторые игровые режимы исключают папки: Some game modes exclude Steam and Epic folders from the index or stop the search service while you play.
en.Индексатор сам останавливается в игровом: The indexer stops by itself in Game Mode and when CPU load is above 80% or disk load above 70% (since Windows 10 2004). Excluding folders saves nothing while playing, and stopping the service breaks search in Start and File Explorer.
en.Страница «Автозапуск и службы» объясняет: The Startup & services page explains what Windows Search does; the game session does not touch it.
en.Некоторые оптимизаторы меняют загрузчик: Some optimizers change the boot loader (useplatformclock, disabledynamictick, tscsyncpolicy) or disable HPET in Device Manager.
en.С Windows 8 счётчик времени читается из: Since Windows 8 the time counter is read from the CPU's TSC, which is cheap; HPET and ACPI timers are slower and shared by all cores. Forcing the “platform timer” only adds overhead, and disabling dynamic ticks raises idle power consumption. Forum results are contradictory and subjective.
en.Ничего менять не нужно; «Отчёт об энерго: There is nothing to change; the “Energy efficiency report” shows the real timer owners.
en.Многие оптимизаторы ищут «ошибки реестра: Many optimizers look for “registry errors” and offer to delete hundreds of entries.
en.Microsoft не поддерживает программы чист: Microsoft does not support registry cleaners and warns that damage may require reinstalling the system. There is no benefit: registry hives are mapped into memory, and a few orphaned keys cost nothing.
en.Проверка и восстановление системных файл: Checking and repairing system files (SFC, DISM) is in Maintenance → Repair & disks.
en.Отключить или урезать файл подкачки: Disable or shrink the page file
en.Некоторые руководства выключают файл под: Some guides turn the page file off “at 32 GB of memory” or enable ClearPageFileAtShutdown and DisablePagingExecutive.
en.Лимит выделяемой памяти равен ОЗУ плюс ф: The commit limit equals RAM plus the page file: without it, games and programs crash with an “out of memory” error while physical memory is still free. The other keys are server settings with no effect on games; wiping the file at shutdown only slows shutdown down.
en.Пункт «Файл подкачки: автоматический раз: The “Page file: automatic size” option in Optimize and the memory facts on the Dashboard.
en.Некоторые игровые бустеры ставят процесс: Some game boosters set the game process to “Realtime” priority.
en.Microsoft: этот класс почти никогда нель: Microsoft: this class should almost never be used — it preempts the system threads for mouse and keyboard input and disk cache flushing, so input and audio start to stutter. Anti-cheats may also react to it.
en.Игровой сеанс в «Играх» поднимает игру н: The game session in Games raises the game no higher than “High” priority and only while you play.
en.Некоторые «ускорители пинга» отключают р: Some “ping boosters” disable checksum offloads, LSO, RSS and interrupt moderation in the network card driver.
en.Microsoft: включённые разгрузки, как пра: Microsoft: enabled offloads are generally beneficial, and disabling checksums also disables RSS, RSC and LSO. Ping doesn't change, CPU core load goes up, and changing adapter settings drops the connection.
en.Факты об адаптере и замеры сети — на стр: Adapter facts and network tests are on the Devices & network page.
